classes.name: Swordsman
classes.summary: Swordsman is the go-to "tank" of the six first jobs. With high HP, access to great defensive gear, and skill options to boost sustain and reduce damage taken, they are adept at getting into bigger fights than they can handle and finding a way to come out on the other side.

skills.name: Sword Mastery
skills.text: Increases the damage of One-Handed Swords.

skills.name: Slash
skills.text: Deals two quick hits, with a chance to inflict the Bleed status on enemies.

skills.name: Lash Out
skills.text: Strike all enemies around the user.

skills.name: Improved Constitution
skills.text: Increases the effects of healing items that restore HP, and restore a small amount of HP every 10 seconds the user isn't moving.

skills.name: Provoke
skills.text: Attempts to grab the attention of a distant mob and inflict the Vulnerable status on them.

classes.name: Knight
classes.summary: Knight is the primary advancement option for the Swordsman class. Like Swordsmen before them, Knights rely on naturally high HP, high defensive stats from their available equipment, and increased potion efficiency to sustain themselves in encounters.

skills.name: Two-Handed Sword Mastery
skills.text: Passive.

skills.name: Rend
skills.text: Sword Skill.

skills.name: Devastating Blow
skills.text: Sword Finisher skill.

skills.name: Quicken
skills.text: Sword skill.

skills.name: Spear Mastery
skills.text: Passive.

classes.name: Lord Knight
classes.summary: Lord Knight is the primary advancement option for Knights. It continues the original path of the knight, tight, rotation based skill patterns, and expands it, adding new skills that can serve as replacements for old skills to enhance the Knight level rotations, or that can slot in happily beside them adding a second full rotation to the menu, filling much of the downtime Knights experienced in their combat with new skills.

skills.name: Vanguard Stance
skills.text: The user shifts into an offensive stance, optimizing their ability to deal damage.

skills.name: Warden Stance
skills.text: The user shifts into a defensive stance, maximizing their survivability.

skills.name: Sonic Wave
skills.text: Flexible Skill.

skills.name: Shattering Strike
skills.text: Flexible Skill.

skills.name: Flourish
skills.text: Sword Skill.

classes.name: Rune Knight
classes.summary: Rune Knight is the alternative advancement option for Knights. While the Lord Knight continues the orthodox style of the Knight, expanding its stable rotations with more skills that function in much the same way, the Rune Knight takes an entirely different direction.

skills.name: Rune Research
skills.text: Research into the nature and use of Rune Magic.

skills.name: Rune Inscription
skills.text: Study into the creation of Rune Stones, single-use items that can be slotted into equipment in the same manner as cards.

skills.name: Winter Razor
skills.text: Releases a blast of icy wind around the user, slicing apart nearby enemies.

skills.name: Ignition Break
skills.text: Creates a burst of mystical fire from the user's weapon, incinerating enemies in the area.

skills.name: Burning Breath
skills.text: Unleashes a burst of flame to envelop the targeted location.

classes.name: Crusader
classes.summary: Crusader is the alternative advancement option for the Swordsman class, marrying the inherent defense and damage mitigation strategies of the Swordsman with the holy magic of the Acolyte.

skills.name: Spear Mastery
skills.text: Passive.

skills.name: Brilliant Strike
skills.text: A plain damage skill that has a high chance to inflict the Blind status.

skills.name: Holy Cross
skills.text: Deals two consecutive hits of Holy property physical damage.

skills.name: Spear Flurry
skills.text: Increases the user's attack speed for a short duration.

skills.name: Faith
skills.text: Passive.

classes.name: Paladin
classes.summary: Paladin is the primary advancement option for the Crusader. It acts as an extension of the Crusader skill tree, expanding their rotations and replacing some of the lower level skills with higher powered ones.

skills.name: Castigating Aura
skills.text: Enchants the user's weapon with the Holy property, increases the user's Hit, and grants all Paladin skills additional effects based on damaging and disabling enemies.

skills.name: Providence
skills.text: Enchants the user's armor with the Holy Property, increases their Perfect Dodge, and grants all Paladin skills additional effects focused on protecting and sustaining the user.

skills.name: Sanctify
skills.text: Creates an area of consecrated ground that buffs the Atk, Matk, Def, and Mdef of all allies within, while periodically inflicting Holy Property damage on all enemies.

skills.name: Banishing Strike
skills.text: Spear skill.

skills.name: Overbrand
skills.text: Spear Skill.

classes.name: Royal Guard
classes.summary: Royal Guard is the alternative advancement option for Crusaders. While Paladins focus on infusing the Crusader's playstyle with additional holy might, the Royal Guard instead opts to turn to sheer physical prowess to protect their allies and dispatch their foes.

skills.name: Radiant Sweep
skills.text: Spear Skill.

skills.name: Impale
skills.text: Spear Skill.

skills.name: Cannon Spear
skills.text: Spear Skill.

skills.name: Shield Press
skills.text: Shield Skill.

skills.name: Shield Shooting
skills.text: Shield Skill.

classes.name: Merchant
classes.summary: The Merchant is the "Bruiser" of the first jobs. Merchants aim to survive their fights in the simplest way possible: kill the enemy fast enough that it can't kill you.

skills.name: Axe Mastery
skills.text: Boosts the damage and Hit rate of One and Two-Handed Axes.

skills.name: Axe Boomerang
skills.text: Throws the user's axe at a distant target, knocking them back a few cells and also having a chance to inflict the Stun status.

skills.name: Crush
skills.text: Delivers a single heavy blow to the target with a chance to Stun them.

skills.name: Extort
skills.text: Deals a small amount of damage to an enemy, increasing the user's "coin" count by one.

skills.name: Mammonite
skills.text: Deals heavy damage to a single target.

classes.name: Blacksmith
classes.summary: Blacksmith is the primary advancement option for the Merchant. In keeping with the Merchant's strategy of "damage over all else," the Blacksmith class has virtually nothing in the way of defensive options, relying on good equipment and exceptional damage output to see it through most encounters.

skills.name: Steel Heart
skills.text: Passive.

skills.name: Adrenaline Rush
skills.text: Increases the user's Attack Speed and Hit Rate for a duration.

skills.name: Weapon Perfection
skills.text: Removes the size penalty of all weapons, while also increasing the Critical Damage of autoattacks.

skills.name: Power Thrust
skills.text: Increases the damage of all skills used by a small amount, while greatly increasing the damage and Defense Pierce of autoattacks.

skills.name: Rush Down
skills.text: The user rushes to a distant target, dealing significant damage that can be Critical.

classes.name: Mastersmith
classes.summary: Mastersmith is the primary advancement option for the Blacksmith. It very much continues in the same vein as the Blacksmith before it: build lots of damage and hope the enemy dies before you do, relying almost entirely on gear to build up the survivability needed to make your way through each encounter while your skills deal the maximum damage possible, making those encounters as short as possible.

skills.name: Meltdown
skills.text: The user superheats their weapon, passively increasing their Burning Damage and giving their Whirling Axe procs a chance to inflict the Severe Burning status.

skills.name: Whirling Axe
skills.text: The user adopts a wild, whirling fighting style, passively giving their attacks a chance to splash in a 5x5 area around them.

skills.name: Berserk
skills.text: The user enters a battle frenzy, gaining massive Damage Reduction, Attack, and ASPD for the duration.

skills.name: Overwhelm
skills.text: Slams into the enemy with tremendous force, generating a stack of Extort.

skills.name: Cleave
skills.text: Delivers a sundering blow to the enemy, shredding any protective abilities.

classes.name: Mechanic
classes.summary: Mechanic is the alternative advancement option for Blacksmiths. While the Mastersmith focuses their efforts on drawing the maximum possible power out of the equipment they and their friends use, the Mechanic turns to creating brand new tools to aid them in combat.

skills.name: Madogear Construction
skills.text: Skill in the construction of Madogear, a mechanical suit of power armor that enhances the user's abilities.

skills.name: Machine Slam
skills.text: Madogear Skill.

skills.name: Arm Cannon
skills.text: Madogear Skill.

skills.name: Active Shielding
skills.text: Madogear Skill.

skills.name: Overdrive
skills.text: Madogear Skill.

classes.name: Alchemist
classes.summary: Alchemist is the alternative advancement option for the Merchant. Unlike its first class, the Alchemist enjoys multiple possible playstyles, from the very familiar "all gas no breaks" style of the Merchant to more defensive and supportive options.

skills.name: Chemical Research
skills.text: "Mastery" skill for Chemical-type skills.

skills.name: Acid Terror
skills.text: Deals significant Ranged Physical damage to a distant target with a chance to inflict the Vulnerable status.

skills.name: Demonstration
skills.text: Ignites a small fire at the targeted location, dealing constant Fire property damage to enemies in a small area around it.

skills.name: Conflagration
skills.text: Consumes all of the user's Extort stacks to deal massive Ranged Physical damage over a wide area.

skills.name: Enhancement Research
skills.text: Passive.

classes.name: Biochemist
classes.summary: Biochemist is the primary advancement option for Alchemists. They turn their insatiable curiosity for the workings of chemical matter toward the interaction of chemicals with each other and organic bodies.

skills.name: Greater Aid Potion
skills.text: Throws a potion and scatters its contents over a wide area, healing all allies within its range.

skills.name: Incinerate
skills.text: Chemical Skill.

skills.name: Acidic Cloud
skills.text: Chemical Skill.

skills.name: Alchemic Cannon
skills.text: Chemical Skill.

skills.name: Acid Demonstration
skills.text: Chemical Skill.

classes.name: Geneticist
classes.summary: The Geneticist is the alternate advancement option for Alchemists. They turn away from research into chemicals and potions and instead focus on the study of life itself.

skills.name: Fauna Specialization
skills.text: Increases the stats of summoned Homunculi, and enhances the effects of all Fauna-type Geneticist skills.

skills.name: Gift of Life
skills.text: Sacrifices a portion of the user's HP to heal all allies in the area, including summoned entities.

skills.name: Gift of Light
skills.text: Shines a holy light on the user and their summoned entities, protecting them from harm.

skills.name: Gift of Venom
skills.text: Creates a pool of toxic venom on the ground, dealing constant Poison property damage and attempting to slow enemies within it.

skills.name: Gift of Flame
skills.text: Invokes a burst of flame at the target's location, dealing Fire damage to enemies in the area with a chance to inflict the Burning status.

classes.name: Thief
classes.summary: The Thief occupies a role somewhere between the Swordsman and the Merchant. With more than half of its skill tree dedicated to defensive options, Thieves are remarkably resilient even with their lower HP pools.

skills.name: Dagger Mastery
skills.text: Increases the damage and Double Attack rate of Daggers.

skills.name: Envenom
skills.text: Deals minor poison damage, with a chance to inflict the Poison status.

skills.name: Sand Attack
skills.text: Deals a fair amount of Neutral damage at a small range, with a chance to inflict the Blind status.

skills.name: Nimbleness
skills.text: Increases the base Flee and Movement Speed.

skills.name: Hiding
skills.text: Hides under the ground to avoid all attacks for a brief time.

classes.name: Assassin
classes.summary: The Assassin is the primary advancement option for the Thief class. While the Thief's skill tree was very much defensively minded, the Assassin uses that foundation to fill their skill bar with offensive options.

skills.name: Toxic Blades
skills.text: Blade Enchant.

skills.name: Flashing Blades
skills.text: Blade Enchant.

skills.name: Rejuvenating Blades
skills.text: Blade Enchant.

skills.name: Katar Mastery
skills.text: Passive.

skills.name: Grimtooth
skills.text: Katar Skill.

classes.name: Assassin Cross
classes.summary: Assassin Cross is the primary advancement option for Assassins. In contrast to the Guillotine Cross, which devotes its entire arsenal to the perfection and use of a variety of poisons, the Assassin Cross seeks to perfect their own martial skill.

skills.name: Peerless Blades
skills.text: Infuses the user's weapons with their own life force, providing strong benefits while the user's HP remains high.

skills.name: Deadly Shadow
skills.text: The user turns invisible for a short time.

skills.name: Soul Destroyer
skills.text: The user channels their active Blade Enchant into a deadly projectile and fires it at an enemy.

skills.name: Flashing Blades Bonus
skills.text: Guaranteed to Crit, ignores Physical Defense

skills.name: Rejuvenating Blades Bonus
skills.text: Reduces all active skill cooldowns by 5 Seconds

classes.name: Guillotine Cross
classes.summary: Guillotine Cross is the alternative advancement option for Assassins. While Assassin Crosses eschew dependency on Poison for their damage, preferring to rely entirely on combat skill, the Guillotine Cross has no such inhibitions.

skills.name: Fatal Blades
skills.text: Blade Enchant.

skills.name: Level 1
skills.text: Increases the duration of Poison inflicted

skills.name: Level 2
skills.text: Poison also inflicts Blind.

skills.name: Level 3
skills.text: Poison Damage is increased by a portion of the user's Bleeding and Burning Damage.

skills.name: Level 4
skills.text: Whenever Poison ticks, it has a chance to spread to all allies of the victim in a short range.

classes.name: Rogue
classes.summary: Rogue is the secondary advancement option for the Thief. While the Assassin turns its efforts towards putting out raw damage supplemented by the Status Effects offered by their Thief roots, the Rogue focuses primarily on putting those Status Effects , and as many others as possible , to good use.

skills.name: Predatory Instinct
skills.text: Stance.

skills.name: Disorient
skills.text: Slashes at a target and vanishes, putting the user in the Hiding state and attempting to inflict the Vulnerable status on the enemy.

skills.name: Backstab
skills.text: Snaps behind the target to deliver a lethal blow.

skills.name: Ambush
skills.text: Leaps from Hiding to deal damage across a wide area, attempting to inflict the Blind and Vulnerable statuses to all enemies struck.

skills.name: Malicious Instinct
skills.text: Stance.

classes.name: Stalker
classes.summary: Stalker is the primary advancement option for Rogues. Stalkers perfect the quick and dirty fighting style of the Rogue, either capitalizing on Blind and Vulnerable to cripple their opponent's offenses and defenses, or dealing out a large number of damage statuses in quick succession to keep their foes reeling.

skills.name: Stalker's Instinct
skills.text: The user hones their instincts for dirty fighting, taking every battlefield advantage they can and leaving their opponents no opportunity to fight back.

skills.name: Lightning Reflexes
skills.text: The user responds instantly to an incoming attack, preventing the damage and taking advantage of the enemy's now misdirected momentum.

skills.name: Level 1
skills.text: Increased Movement Speed for a short time.

skills.name: Level 2
skills.text: Inflicts Blind on the enemy.

skills.name: Level 3
skills.text: Inflicts Vulnerable on the enemy.

classes.name: Shadow Chaser
classes.summary: The Shadow Chaser is the alternative advancement option for Rogues.

skills.name: Needle Burst
skills.text: Unleashes a burst of razor sharp needles, dealing damage that is treated as Bleeding damage and inflicting the Bleeding status on both the target and the user.

skills.name: Scalding Blade
skills.text: Delivers a searing strike to the enemy, dealing damage that is treated as Burning damage and inflicting the Burning status on both the target and the user.

skills.name: Plague Touch
skills.text: The user cloaks themselves in noxious fumes before striking the target, dealing damage that is treated as Poison damage and inflicting the Poison status on both the target and the user.

skills.name: Malicious Reprisal
skills.text: The user delivers a retaliatory strike against all enemies in the area around them, inflicting exceptional Physical damage.

skills.name: Bloodletter's Mark
skills.text: The user draws a cursed mark on the target, inflaming their Bleeding status.

classes.name: Mage
classes.summary: Mage occupies a similar role to the Archer, but shoulders more risk while gunning for a higher reward. The Mage has access to a suite of high damage Bolts of varying elements, allowing them to capitalize on enemy weaknesses where other classes are forced to deal Neutral damage, coupled with a host of AoE skills that can inflict various status effects to multiple enemies simultaneously.

skills.name: Magical Attunement
skills.text: Restores SP for the user while they are not moving, reduces the SP cost of all skills, and increases the effectiveness of consumables that restore SP.

skills.name: Fire Bolt
skills.text: Deals heavy fire element damage to a single target, which is increased if the target is Burning.

skills.name: Fire Ball
skills.text: Does minor fire damage to an area, with a high chance of inflicting the Burning status on all targets struck.

skills.name: Cold Bolt
skills.text: Deals heavy water element damage to a single target, which is increased if the target is Chilled.

skills.name: Frost Blast
skills.text: Deals minor water element damage to an area, with a high chance of inflicting the Chilled status on all targets struck.

classes.name: Wizard
classes.summary: Wizard is the primary advancement option for the Mage.

skills.name: Cloak of Flame
skills.text: The user wraps themselves in flame, dealing Fire property damage to all enemies that approach within a 5x5 area.

skills.name: Crimson Rock
skills.text: Calls a flaming meteor from the heavens to deal heavy Fire property damage and inflict the Burning status to a target and all enemies around it.

skills.name: Freezing Breath
skills.text: Unleashes a blast of cold air at a target location, dealing Water property damage and attempting to inflict the Chilled and Water Vulnerability statuses.

skills.name: Storm Gust
skills.text: Summons a wintry storm at the targeted location, dealing repeated Water property damage with a chance to inflict the Chilled status each time.

skills.name: Jupitel Thunder
skills.text: Fires a ball of lightning at a target, knocking them back and inflicting the Wind Vulnerability status for ten seconds.

classes.name: High Wizard
classes.summary: High Wizard is the primary advancement option for Wizards. It continues to excel at what the Wizard does best - dish out huge amounts of elemental damage over a wide area.

skills.name: Affinities
skills.text: Affinities come in the four natural elements, Fire, Water, Wind, or Earth.

skills.name: Crimson Arrow
skills.text: The user fires a bolt of concentrated Fire Magic, striking all targets in a straight line.

skills.name: Volcanic Burst
skills.text: The user causes a burst of blazing magical energy to erupt beneath their target's feet, dealing Fire damage to them and all enemies around them.

skills.name: Frozen Grip
skills.text: The user summons spikes of ice at the target's location, dealing Water property damage to them and all enemies nearby.

skills.name: Frost Nova
skills.text: The user unleashes a blast of freezing magic around themselves, dealing Water Property damage to all enemies in an area around them.

classes.name: Warlock
classes.summary: Warlock is the alternative advancement option for Wizards. While their previous job provided them mastery over all of the natural elements, the Warlock is not satisfied with this, and so turns its efforts toward much darker magics.

skills.name: Void Infusion
skills.text: Converts all magic damage dealt by the user to the specified element.

skills.name: Ghost
skills.text: The user's Magic Pierce is reduced to 0

skills.name: Undead
skills.text: The user loses 5% of their Max HP every 5 seconds

skills.name: Void Channeling
skills.text: The user consumes a portion of their Max HP to channel the power of the void, condensing it into spheres that can be used as a resource to empower other skills.

skills.name: Phantasmal Burst
skills.text: Invokes forbidden magic to turn the target's soul against their own body, dealing Ghost property damage and inflicting the Breach status.

classes.name: Sage
classes.summary: Sage is the secondary advancement option for Mages. While the Wizard focuses mainly on turning the control options of Mage into large amounts of damage, the Sage doubles down on the control aspect of their first job, using their new skills to further restrict their enemies' movements, all while dealing consistent damage over a wide area.

skills.name: Elemental Mastery
skills.text: Passive.

skills.name: Fire Wall
skills.text: Creates a wall of fire that will inflict minor damage and knock back enemies trying to pass through it.

skills.name: Inferno
skills.text: Summons a blazing inferno at the targeted location, dealing Fire property damage over time to all enemies within.

skills.name: Chilling Frost
skills.text: Creates a blast of cold air at the targeted location, dealing minor Water property damage and attempting to Chill all enemies in a wide area.

skills.name: Deluge
skills.text: Summons a raging torrent at the targeted location, dealing Water property damage over time to all enemies within.

classes.name: Scholar
classes.summary: Scholar is the primary advancement option for the Sage. Similar to the Warlock, Scholars are those who have contented themselves with their mastery over the natural elements and so have turned their attention to other forces.

skills.name: Free Cast
skills.text: Enables the user to walk and attack at reduced speed while casting spells.

skills.name: Soul Siphon
skills.text: The user connects their soul to that of the targeted foe, directly siphoning their magical energy.

skills.name: Time Shift
skills.text: The user uses their ultimate mastery over the inner workings of the world to shift time forward for their party.

skills.name: Indulge
skills.text: The user consumes a portion of their HP, converting it into SP.

skills.name: Soul Infusion
skills.text: The user infuses a targeted ally with arcane magics, fuelling their skills for a short duration.

classes.name: Sorcerer
classes.summary: Sorcerer is the alternative advancement option for Sages. While the Scholar focuses its efforts on learning about and leveraging the unique attributes of magic itself, the Sorcerer turns their focus toward the four elemental attributes, manipulating them with control and precision that even the most powerful Wizards would be jealous of.

skills.name: Summon Ardor
skills.text: Summons Ardor, the spirit of indomitable fire, to aid in combat.

skills.name: Agni's Wrath
skills.text: The user calls on Agni, spirit of flame, to incinerate their foes.

skills.name: Agni's Heat
skills.text: The user calls on Agni, the spirit of flame, to infuse the targeted area with unnatural heat.

skills.name: Summon Diluvio
skills.text: Summons Diluvio, the spirit of the endless ocean depths, to aid in combat.

skills.name: Aqua's Breath
skills.text: Calls on Aqua, the spirit of water, to strike down their foes, creating a blast of frigid snow and ice to strike the targeted area.

classes.name: Archer
classes.summary: The Archer fills both a damage and offensive support role. With extended range from their bows, they are able to engage enemies from a safe distance and put out steady damage without needing to worry about taking much damage themselves.

skills.name: Bow Mastery
skills.text: Increases the auto-attack range and Hit Rate of Bows.

skills.name: Double Strafe
skills.text: Deals two hits in rapid succession to a ranged target.

skills.name: Arrow Shower
skills.text: Deals splash damage at a target location, knocking back any enemies struck.

skills.name: Pin Down
skills.text: Fires an arrow at a target's legs, dealing minor damage and attempting to inflict the Slow status.

skills.name: Arrow Repel
skills.text: Fires a heavy arrow at the target, dealing minor damage and knocking them backwards.

classes.name: Hunter
classes.summary: Hunter is the primary advancement option for the Archer class. It fills much the same role, attempting to finish off enemies from range, but now has a few more tools to aid in the process.

skills.name: Marksman's Focus
skills.text: Self buff.

skills.name: Precision Shot
skills.text: Takes careful aim at a target before firing, dealing significant damage that is increased against Slowed enemies.

skills.name: Threefold Arrow
skills.text: Three part skill.

skills.name: Trapper's Focus
skills.text: Self buff.

skills.name: Toxic Mine
skills.text: Sets a trap that spews a cloud of poisonous gas when triggered.

classes.name: Sniper
classes.summary: Sniper is the primary advancement option for Hunters. It gives up on the usage of both traps and Falcon skills to perfect the use of the bow, becoming something of a Physical Caster designed to bring down enemies from a safe distance.

skills.name: Sniper's Resolve
skills.text: The user steels themselves, determined to keep fighting no matter the odds.

skills.name: Tactical Retreat
skills.text: The user instantly jumps to the targeted location, moving them out of harm's way, then refreshes all active Preparation Counters.

skills.name: Called Shot
skills.text: The user marks a target for elimination.

skills.name: Shrouding Shot
skills.text: The user fires an arrow cloaked in dark fog to inhibit the target's vision.

skills.name: Hammer Shot
skills.text: Fires an arrow with tremendous force, keeping the target from reaching the user.

classes.name: Ranger
classes.summary: Ranger is the alternative advancement option for Hunters. While it provides some support for Marksman and Falcon builds from the Hunter, it focuses most of its efforts on the trapping style of combat, preferring to best their enemies through careful planning and preparation, creating a battlefield that gives them every advantage possible.

skills.name: Hawk Rush
skills.text: Commands the falcon in a joint maneuver, ordering to to strike the target while granting the user a short boost boost to their Attack Speed.

skills.name: Punishing Bolt
skills.text: The user fires an arrow to take advantage of the opponent's Statuses.

skills.name: Gale Storm
skills.text: The user fires a hail of enchanted arrows, raining them down on a wide area together with a vicious wind.

skills.name: Advanced Trap Mastery
skills.text: Training in the advanced deployment of traps.

skills.name: Wind Trap
skills.text: The user sets a persistent trap that deals Wind property damage to all enemies around it at regular intervals.

classes.name: Bard and Dancer
classes.summary: Bard and Dancer are the secondary advancement options for Archers. Setting aside their bows, the two performer classes opt for a much more challenging playstyle: it's not good enough to just deal damage, the damage has to be dealt with style!

skills.name: Musical Mastery
skills.text: Passive.

skills.name: Restorative Refrain
skills.text: Plays a gentle song to encourage and reinvigorate the party, healing all party members a small amount over time.

skills.name: Quickening Chorus
skills.text: Plays an energetic song to inspire the party to quick action.

skills.name: Darkening Dirge
skills.text: Plays a haunting melody to cloud the minds, and eyes, of enemies.

skills.name: Enervating Elegy
skills.text: Plays an eerie tune that saps the energy from enemies, leaving them weak and vulnerable.

classes.name: Clown/Gypsy
classes.summary: Clown and Gypsy are the primary advancement option for Bards and Dancers. Unlike most third jobs, where the primary advancement option sticks close in theme and function to the original job, Clown and Gypsy both diverge quite significantly from the playstyle of Bard and Dancer.

skills.name: Voluminous Volley
skills.text: The user fires a volley of arrows at a distant target, hitting a number of times based on their Rhythm level for physical damage.

skills.name: Ravaging Rainstorm
skills.text: The user fires a volley of enchanted arrows to rain on a distant area, inflicting physical damage repeatedly to all targets within over time.

skills.name: Rhythmic Retort
skills.text: The user fires a bolt of sound at a distance target, inflicting magic damage while altering their own Rhythm level.

skills.name: Crushing Concerto
skills.text: Creates a powerful burst of sound, dealing devastating magical damage to all enemies in a small area.

skills.name: Tarot Card
skills.text: The Magician: Bestows the blessing of the Magician on the targeted ally, increasing all damage dealt by their magical attacks for a short time.

classes.name: Minstrel/Wanderer
classes.summary: Minstrel and Wanderer are the alternative advancement options for Bard and Dancer. They pick up the support mantle that the Clown and Gypsy abandoned, enhancing the already impressive support abilities of the Bard and Dancer with their own unique twist.

skills.name: Improvised Interlude
skills.text: The user improvises a melody, reaching a crescendo in their performance exactly when it's needed.

skills.name: Desperate Dynamic
skills.text: The user adds a powerful chord to their performance, preparing for a desperate and grand climax.

skills.name: Melodic Mark
skills.text: Applies a musical curse to the target, dealing a small amount of damage and making them vulnerable to further abilities coming from the user.

skills.name: Sonorant Spike
skills.text: The user sings a screeching note, triggering all of their Melodic Marks to deal damage to their targets.

skills.name: Ruinous Rhapsody
skills.text: The user sings a terrifying note, triggering all of their Melodic Marks to deal Magic Damage, inflict the Burning Status, and then reset the duration of their Marks.

classes.name: Acolyte
classes.summary: Though the Acolyte finds its roots in the support classes of old, don't let that fool you. Acolytes are more than capable of braving the wilds on their own, with access to a number of damaging skills beyond just offensive Heal.

skills.name: Heal
skills.text: Instantly recovers a large amount of HP for the target.

skills.name: Blessing
skills.text: Increases the Hit, Flee, and Perfect Dodge of the target for a lengthy duration.

skills.name: Piety
skills.text: Improves the users Max SP, SP Regeneration, and Healing Power.

skills.name: Mace Mastery
skills.text: Increases the damage and Hit Rate of Maces.

skills.name: Holy Light
skills.text: Deals Holy element magic damage to a single target, which is increased if the caster is under the Aspersio status.

classes.name: Priest
classes.summary: Priest is the primary advancement option for the Acolyte. Much like the Acolyte, Priests have a solid mixture of supportive abilities meant to keep themselves and their party alive, as well as powerful offensive abilities specialized for exorcizing the undead and unnatural.

skills.name: Divine Grace
skills.text: Passive.

skills.name: Aspersio
skills.text: Grace Skill.

skills.name: Renovatio
skills.text: Grace Skill.

skills.name: Impositio Manus
skills.text: Grace Skill.

skills.name: Offertorium
skills.text: Grace Skill.

classes.name: High Priest
classes.summary: High Priest is the primary advancement option for Priests. High Priest very much follows in the same footsteps as the Priest, dividing their skills cleanly between Grace and Authority, and allowing skills of either side to enhance the skill levels of the other if used in the correct order.

skills.name: Lux Divina
skills.text: The user is blessed by the divine light of Heaven, granting them unprecedented ability to call on miracles to aid their allies.

skills.name: Lux Aeterna
skills.text: The user is blessed by the eternal light of Heaven, granting them unprecedented ability to call down holy wrath on their foes.

skills.name: Coluceo Heal
skills.text: Grace Skill.

skills.name: Gloria
skills.text: Grace Skill.

skills.name: Magnificat
skills.text: Grace Skill.

classes.name: Arch Bishop
classes.summary: Arch Bishop is the alternative advancement option for Priests. While the Priest divided its skills between supportive Grace Skills and offensive Authority skills, the Arch Bishop instead divides its skills into three general branches, each of which offering a Grace Skill, an Authority Skill, and an unaligned skill to tie them together.

skills.name: Oratio
skills.text: Grace Skill.

skills.name: Arbitrium
skills.text: Authority Skill.

skills.name: Adoramus
skills.text: Unaligned Skill.

skills.name: Grace Heal
skills.text: Grace Skill.

skills.name: Argutus Vita
skills.text: Authority Skill.

classes.name: Monk
classes.summary: Monk is the secondary advancement option for the Acolyte class. It forgoes the majority of its ancestor's supportive potential to focus on closing out fights in the best way possible: damage, damage, and more damage.

skills.name: Spiritual Discipline
skills.text: Passive.

skills.name: Soul Piercer
skills.text: Spirit skill.

skills.name: Spiritual Lash
skills.text: Spirit Skill.

skills.name: Soul Quake
skills.text: Spirit Finisher.

skills.name: Fist Mastery
skills.text: Passive.

classes.name: Champion
classes.summary: Champion is the primary advancement option for the Monk. While Monks found themselves with the option to dedicate themselves to either Spiritual or Combo skills, the Champion seeks to marry these two skill branches together into a perfect harmony.

skills.name: Zen
skills.text: The user calms their mind and relaxes their body, drawing out their true inner strength and exceeding their limits for a brief moment.

skills.name: Unburden
skills.text: The user releases themselves of all worldly attachments, freeing themselves to focus solely on the enemy before them.

skills.name: Raging Barrage
skills.text: Combo Skill.

skills.name: Raging Windmill
skills.text: Combo Skill.

skills.name: Falling Mountain
skills.text: Combo Finisher.

classes.name: Sura
classes.summary: Sura is the alternative advancement option for the Monk. While Champion sought to bring the Combo and Spirit sides of the Monk tree into harmony, the Sura doubles down on specialization, preferring to focus entirely on one side and drawing out its maximum potential.

skills.name: Burning Faith
skills.text: Passively increases the damage dealt by Sura skills against enemies with Stigmata Stacks.

skills.name: Resolute Faith
skills.text: Passively reduces the damage taken from enemies that have any Stigmata stacks.

skills.name: Judge's Conviction
skills.text: The user channels their inner fury, preparing to turn it against all enemies in the area around them.

skills.name: Furious Thrust
skills.text: The user throws a quick jab, delivering tremendous force with the minimum motion possible.

skills.name: Furious Barrage
skills.text: The user unleashes a rapid barrage of strikes against a single target, dealing significant damage and inflicting two stacks of Stigmata.

classes.name: Taekwon
classes.summary: The Taekwon is the first of the Expanded Classes, a group of classes outside the core six starter classes that sport somewhat more complicated class mechanics than usual, and may have somewhat abnormal class structures.

skills.name: Martial Training
skills.text: Training in basic combat and physical fitness.

skills.name: Martial Endurance
skills.text: Training in endurance and perseverance.

skills.name: Martial Discipline
skills.text: Training in focus and discipline.

skills.name: Martial Precision
skills.text: Training in precise and accurate technique.

skills.name: Martial Agility
skills.text: Training in rapid and flexible movement.

classes.name: Star Gladiator
classes.summary: The Star Gladiator is the first advancement option for the Taekwon. Though it still utilizes some of the core Taekwon skills, it begins the journey of moving away from simple martial arts and into wielding cosmic powers beyond that any other job can hope to harness.

skills.name: Cosmic Insight
skills.text: Passive.

skills.name: Solar Heat
skills.text: Cosmic Alignment.

skills.name: Solar Pulse
skills.text: The user delivers a blazing kick, inflicting damage that is increased by the user's Int and has a high chance to inflict the Burning status.

skills.name: Lunar Protection
skills.text: Cosmic Alignment.

skills.name: Lunar Glow
skills.text: The user shines with the light of the Moon, concentrating it into their hands and feet to deal a powerful blow to a single enemy.

classes.name: Star Emperor
classes.summary: Star Emperor is the primary advancement option for Star Gladiators. The Star Emperor fully embraces the cosmic powers of the Star Gladiator, all but abandoning their roots in Taekwon Do to draw themselves closer to the cosmos.

skills.name: Solar Flash
skills.text: The user channels the power of the Sun into a single focused strike, dealing a small amount of damage and inflicting the Burning status.

skills.name: Solar Prominence
skills.text: The user channels the power of the Sun, unleashing it in a burst around them to deal damage to all nearby enemies.

skills.name: Lunar Eclipse
skills.text: The user channels the power of the Moon, infusing it into a single strike that then hides them from their enemies.

skills.name: Lunar Advent
skills.text: The user channels the power of the Moon, unleashing it to deal devastating damage to a single foe.

skills.name: Stellar Flicker
skills.text: The user channels the power of the Stars, striking a single target for moderate physical damage and briefly marking them.

classes.name: Sky Emperor
classes.summary: Sky Emperor is the alternative advancement option for Star Gladiators. While the Star Emperor expands their abilities by drawing closer to the cosmos, the Sky Emperor focuses their efforts on how those same celestial bodies interact with the earth, tracking their movements through the sky to draw their power out.

skills.name: Sunrise
skills.text: Draws on the light of the sun, striking enemies with an attempt to inflict various statuses.

skills.name: Brilliant Noon
skills.text: Calls down the wrath of the noonday sun to scorch their target.

skills.name: Duskfall
skills.text: The user calls on the power of the setting sun to finish off their opponent.

skills.name: Moonrise
skills.text: Draws on the power of the moon to strike all nearby enemies.

skills.name: Dead of Night
skills.text: The user delivers a whirling kick, scattering enemies with the power of the moon.

classes.name: Soul Linker
classes.summary: While the Star Gladiator begins the process of distancing themselves from their roots in Taekwon Do, the Soul Linker wastes no time, abandoning them immediately and without hesitation.

skills.name: Soul Harmony
skills.text: Mastery.

skills.name: Vicious Possession
skills.text: The user calls on the soul of a bloodthirsty warrior to inhabit their body, borrowing a portion of their strength.

skills.name: Spectral Thrust
skills.text: The user unleashes a burst of spectral energy, striking and knocking away a targeted enemy.

skills.name: Spectral Claw
skills.text: The user summons a wraith from beyond the grave to lash out at the target, dealing Ghost property Physical damage to them and all enemies in the area, leaving an open wound that makes them more susceptible to Physical damage for a short duration.

skills.name: Spectral Veil
skills.text: The user slips out of the realm of the living, making themselves immune to Physical damage for a single hit.

classes.name: Soul Reaper
classes.summary: Soul Reaper is the primary advancement option for Soul Linkers. Leveraging their mastery over spirits of the dead, the Soul Reaper turns their studies to mastering the wicked and evil spirits that torment the world, turning their malice into a powerful weapon.

skills.name: Evil Spirit Mastery
skills.text: Many Soul Reaper skills call on the power of evil spirits to exert power on their enemies.

skills.name: Spiteful Spirit
skills.text: The user conjures an evil spirit to attack the targeted enemy, dealing Ghost Property magic damage and attempting to inflict the Breach status.

skills.name: Tormented Spirit
skills.text: The user calls a tormented spirit to haunt the targeted enemy, dealing Ghost Property Magic Damage to them and all enemies in an area around them.

skills.name: Doomed Spirit
skills.text: The user conjures a doomed spirit to wreak havoc across the battlefield, dealing Ghost Property Magic Damage in a huge area around them.

skills.name: Spiteful Shade
skills.text: The user conjures a spiteful shade to attack the targeted enemy, dealing Ghost Property Physical Damage and attempting to inflict the Vulnerable Status.

classes.name: Soul Ascetic
classes.summary: Soul Ascetic is the alternative advancement option for Soul Linkers. While Soul Reapers turn their efforts toward studying and mastering the evil spirits that plague the world, Soul Ascetics instead focus on communing with the spirits of the natural world, turning their otherwise aimless, but still very potent, power toward good.

skills.name: Ritual of Invocation
skills.text: The user performs a ritual to invoke the powers of the spirits of the natural world, preparing to wield their power to create powerful phenomena in the physical world.

skills.name: Ritual of Binding
skills.text: The user performs a ritual to subdue the spirits of the natural world, blunting their impact on the physical world.

skills.name: Talisman of Protection
skills.text: The user calls on the spirits of nature to protect the targeted ally, bestowing on them a talisman of protection.

skills.name: Talisman of War
skills.text: The user calls on the spirits of nature to bolster the strength of the targeted ally's attacks, bestowing on them a talisman of war.

skills.name: Curse of Absorption
skills.text: The user calls on the spirits of the natural world to attack the targeted enemy, draining them of strength and weakening their defenses.

classes.name: Ninja
classes.summary: The Ninja seeks to fill the role of the proverbial "jack of all trades." Even at the first job level they possess a wide variety of skills, from melee and gap closers, to ranged and spacing, to single target and AoE magic.

skills.name: Dagger Mastery
skills.text: Mastery.

skills.name: Flashing Steel
skills.text: Strikes the target with a blow faster than the eye can follow.

skills.name: Soaring Steel
skills.text: Dashes through a distant target, dealing three successive blows that inflict physical damage that scales heavily with Dex and Int.

skills.name: Throwing Mastery
skills.text: Training in the art of throwing weapons, such as shurikens, kunai, and Huuma shurikens.

skills.name: Departing Shadow
skills.text: Throws the equipped offhand weapon at a distant target, while the user immediately backslides to safety, granting the Second Art status..

classes.name: Kagemusha
classes.summary: Kagemusha, once known as Kagerou and Oboro, is the primary advancement option for Ninjas. After spending a hundred levels perfecting their use of physical, ranged, and magical combat styles, the Kagemusha continue along the same path, adding explosive power to each style of ninjutsu.

skills.name: Mikiri
skills.text: Perfectly reading the incoming attack, the user evades timely, avoiding all damage and putting themselves in an optimal position to counterattack.

skills.name: Fulminant Steel
skills.text: The user delivers a lightning fast strike, dealing physical damage to a single target.

skills.name: Ravenous Steel
skills.text: The user lashes out around them, dealing heavy physical damage to all enemies in the area around them.

skills.name: Crushing Steel
skills.text: The user deals a massive blow to the targeted enemy, inflicting heavy damage to them and all enemies in the area around them.

skills.name: Shifting Shadow
skills.text: The user marks the ground beneath them, preparing for movement later.

classes.name: Maboroshi
classes.summary: Maboroshi, previously known as Shinkiro and Shiranui, is the alternative advancement option for Ninjas. While the Kagemusha focuses on perfecting the use of their original Ninja techniques, learning advanced ways to make use of their original three Ninja Arts, the Maboroshi decides that original Ninja skills weren't complicated enough, and decides to kick things up a notch.

skills.name: Deadly Mirage
skills.text: The user dashes toward a distant target, dealing a small amount of physical damage and leaving behind a Mirage at their original location.

skills.name: Fading Mirage
skills.text: The user creates a cloud of smoke to hide themselves, immediately dashing toward the targeted location and entering the Cloaking Status for a brief time, leaving a Mirage at their original location.

skills.name: Treacherous Mirage
skills.text: The user wraps themselves in a bewitching illusion, sheltering them from the next skill against them for a short duration.

skills.name: Stalking Mirage
skills.text: Immediately summons three mirages at the user's current location.

skills.name: Prowling Steel
skills.text: The user lashes out around them, striking all enemies in the area around them.

classes.name: Gunslinger
classes.summary: The Gunslinger occupies a space very similar to that of the mage: a ranged character that specializes in dishing out multiple status effects and taking advantage of them to deal exceptional amounts of damage. As one might guess from the name, however, the manner they choose to do this is a bit different.

skills.name: Firearms Mastery
skills.text: Mastery in using Revolvers, Rifles, and Shotguns.

skills.name: Rapid Reload
skills.text: The user rapidly reloads their weapon, preparing to unleash mayhem once again.

skills.name: Redeploy
skills.text: The user instantly repositions, teleporting to a targeted location to which they have line of sight.

skills.name: Quick Draw
skills.text: Revolver skill.

skills.name: Rapid Shower
skills.text: Revolver Finisher.

classes.name: Rebel
classes.summary: Rebel is the primary advancement option for Gunslingers. As with the Gunslinger before them, the Rebel's kit focuses around rapidly switching between Revolvers, Rifles, and Shotguns to deliver a wide range of status effects, using them to maximize their damage potential.

skills.name: Bullet Time
skills.text: The user focuses all of their efforts on defense, enabling them to dodge incoming attacks with ease.

skills.name: Gunslinger's Gambit
skills.text: The user focuses all of their efforts on offense, discarding any pretense of self preservation.

skills.name: Disengage
skills.text: Revolver Skill.

skills.name: Rapid Blitz
skills.text: Revolver Skill.

skills.name: Penetrating Shot
skills.text: Rifle Skill.

classes.name: Night Watch
classes.summary: Night Watch is the alternative advancement option for Gunslingers. Similar to the Rebel, the Night Watch focuses on expanding the original options of the Gunslinger.

skills.name: Revolver Specialization
skills.text: Revolver Skill: The user alters their fighting style to specialize in the use of Revolvers.

skills.name: Quick Draw Bonus
skills.text: Inflicts Vulnerable and Crimson Marker

skills.name: Rapid Shower Bonus
skills.text: Inflicts Internal Bleeding and Crimson Marker

skills.name: Unload Bonus
skills.text: Gain (Skill Lv/3) Grenades instead of 1

skills.name: Unload
skills.text: Revolver Skill.
